description: This file contains shell script code to test the fetch and push functionality of git over HTTP protocol. It defines setup procedures, tests for push behavior with and without negotiation, and verifies the incrementation of objects written during pushes.

methods.name: grep_wrote
methods.description: A helper function that checks the number of objects written during a push by grepping the event log.

methods.name: setup_client_and_server
methods.description: Sets up the client and server repositories, performs initial commits, and configures the server for push testing.
